description: The map's messages: the keys by message number from "first" (the numbers before it are common.json's), and the English text of the original game.

strings.map0_s01.you_from_around_here_why:
{wait 5.0}You from around here?
Why don't you
tell me what happened?
strings.map0_s01.wait_a_second_im_just:
{wait 3.0}Wait a second.
I'm just a tourist.
strings.map0_s01.i_came_here_for_a:
{wait 5.2}I came here for a vacation.
I just got here...
strings.map0_s01.just_turned_seven_last_month:
{wait 4.0}Just turned seven last month...
Short, black hair...
strings.map0_s01.the_only_person_ive_seen:
{wait 3.0}The only person I've seen
in this town is you.
strings.map0_s01.id_tell_you_if_i:
{wait 3.5}I'd tell you if I knew,
believe me.
strings.map0_s01.but_from_what_i_can:
{wait 5.5}But, from what I can tell,
something bizarre is going on.
strings.map0_s01.the_phones_are_all_dead:
{wait 3.0}The phones are all dead,
and the radio, too.
strings.map0_s01.im_going_back_to_call:
{wait 4.0}I'm going back to call
in some reinforcements.
strings.map0_s01.in_that_case_i_need:
{wait 5.0}In that case,
I need to find her now!
Cheryl's my little girl.
strings.map0_s01.i_cant_just_leave_her:
{wait 3.0}I can't just leave her out
there by herself.{end}
strings.map0_s01.take_this_and_hope_you:
{wait 5.0}Take this.
And hope you don't
have to use it.
strings.map0_s01.before_you_pull_the_trigger:
{wait 4.5}before you pull the trigger,
know who you're shooting.
strings.map0_s01.and_dont_do_it_unless:
{wait 3.0}And don't do it
unless you have to.{end}
strings.map0_s01.and_dont_go_blasting_me:
{wait 3.0}And don't go blasting me
by mistake.
strings.map0_s01.there_is_a_residential_area:
{hires}There is a {color 5}Residential area map{/color}.
Take it?{choice 4}
strings.map0_s01.there_is_a_kitchen_knife:
There is a {color 2}Kitchen knife{/color}.
Take it?{choice 4}
strings.map0_s01.huh_radio_whats_going_on:
{wait 4.5}Huh? Radio?
What's going on with that radio?{end}
strings.map0_s01.there_is_a_pocket_radio:
There is a {color 2}Pocket radio{/color}.
Take it?{choice 4}
strings.map0_s01.a_radio_is_it_broken:
A radio...is it broken?
Can't hear anything.{end}
strings.map0_s01.maybe_i_should_check_for:
Maybe I should check for
something useful before leaving.{end}
strings.map0_s01.this_is_not_a_dream:
{wait 4.3}This is not a dream!
What's happening to this place!?{end}
strings.map0_s01.ive_got_to_beat_that: I've got to beat that monster!{end}
strings.map0_s01.the_radio_may_be_useful:
The radio may be
useful for something.
strings.map0_s01.i_better_take_it_with: I better take it with me.{end}
strings.map0_s01.cant_turn_on_the_tv:
Can't turn on the TV.
No power?{end}
strings.map0_s01.i_have_more_important_stuff: I have more important stuff to do.{end}
